title: Design System: Adnan Mashrur Sadad — Portfolio

hero-display.purpose: The single 'Hi, I'm Adnan.' headline only, never reused elsewhere.

metric-value.purpose: Large count-up numbers in metrics/comparison blocks.

project-hook.purpose: The one-line italic-weight hook under each project name.

body.purpose: All prose copy, capped to a comfortable reading measure.

body-secondary-sm.purpose: Work-rail button labels, notes list items, carousel slide body.

label-eyebrow.purpose: Section eyebrows, hero status line, nav, kbd hint, command palette hints.

label-xs.purpose: Tags, rail counters, portrait caption, slab captions, work-rail descriptors.

label-micro.purpose: Diagram comparison-column labels — the smallest text in the system.

shadows.name: modal-float
shadows.purpose: The one true elevated surface — the command palette modal. No other component uses box-shadow.

shadows.name: photo-float
shadows.purpose: Applied via CSS filter (not box-shadow) to portrait photography so it reads as a floating physical object, paired with a faint accent-colored glow.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for nearly every transition in the system — buttons, cards, nav, reveals.

motion.name: ease-flow
motion.purpose: Used specifically for the animated diagram flow-lines (schema-repair loop, simulation diagrams) — a sharper, more mechanical ease than the standard one.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid warm-bone button; fill wipes to signal orange on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 14px 24px; border-radius: 100px; border: 1px solid #F3F0EA; font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.13em; text-transform: uppercase; background: #F3F0EA; color: #0B0B0D; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: #FF6A3D; z-index: -1; transform: translateY(101%); transition: transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover::after { transform: none; } .ds-btn-primary .ds-arw { transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-arw { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF6A3D; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent button with hairline border; fills to warm bone on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 14px 24px; border-radius: 100px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,106,61,0.10); font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.13em; text-transform: uppercase; background: transparent; color: #F3F0EA; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), border-color 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-ghost::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: #F3F0EA; z-index: -1; transform: translateY(101%); transition: transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #0B0B0D; border-color: #FF6A3D; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover::after { transform: none; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF6A3D; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Tag
components.description: Small pill label; the .live/.wip modifier is the only thing that tints it toward signal orange.
components.css: .ds-tag { font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 9.5px; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 100px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,106,61,0.10); color: #8C8A87; } .ds-tag-live { color: #FF6A3D; border-color: rgba(255,106,61,0.32); }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Tech-stack chip; border and text shift to signal orange on hover.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #8C8A87; border: 1px solid rgba(255,106,61,0.10); border-radius: 4px; padding: 5px 9px; transition: border-color 0.3s, color 0.3s; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #FF6A3D; color: #FF6A3D; }

components.name: Bento Cell
components.description: Toolkit/skills card; lifts and gains an accent glow on hover.
components.css: .ds-cell { border: 1px solid rgba(255,106,61,0.10); border-radius: 6px; padding: 22px; background: #131315; position: relative; overflow: hidden; transition: border-color 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-cell:hover { border-color: rgba(255,106,61,0.35); transform: translateY(-3px); } .ds-cell h4 { font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #FF6A3D; margin: 0 0 14px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-cell ul { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; } .ds-cell li { font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10.5px; color: #8C8A87; border: 1px solid rgba(255,106,61,0.05); border-radius: 4px; padding: 4px 8px; background: rgba(237,234,227,0.02); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Underline-free nav link; color-shift only on hover.

narrative.overview:
One warm indicator light against near-total darkness. The system's own code names the accent --signal before it names it --sodium — this isn't a metaphor imposed from outside, it's what the implementation already calls itself. The base surface (--ink, #0B0B0D) sits at the very edge of black, and exactly one hue — a warm orange-red — is allowed to glow against it: a pulsing status dot in the hero, a hover state on a button, the cursor of a running process. Everything else — text, borders, secondary surfaces — stays in a narrow band of warm grays and off-white, so the signal color reads as information, not decoration.

The system is unapologetically technical without being cold. Monospace labels (Geist Mono) carry metadata, timestamps, and status the way a terminal or a build log would; a distinctive 'slab' component renders code and data with syntax-highlight-style inline color (comment / keyword / string / result), reinforcing that this is a working engineer's site, not a marketing template pretending to be one. Photography (the hero portrait, the About section photo) is the one place the system allows itself real depth — soft drop-shadow filters, not flat cards — floating those images above the flat plane everything else lives on.

Confirmed rejection: generic SaaS gradient-and-glassmorphism — gradient text, frosted-glass cards, pastel palettes, rounded-everything softness. None of that belongs here; the system's restraint (one accent, flat surfaces, hairline borders) is the entire point, not a placeholder waiting to be prettied up.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black base with exactly one warm accent color, used sparingly and functionally (status, hover, active states)
Monospace labels for all metadata/status text; a serif-free display face for headlines
Flat by default — depth comes from hairline borders and tonal surface steps, not shadows
A signature 'slab' component renders code/data with terminal-style syntax coloring
Motion is restrained and purposeful: a pulsing status dot, hover-only color shifts, WebGL ambient effects that never demand attention

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: The accent color is used on a small fraction of any given screen, and always to mean something (active, live, hovered, pulsing) — never as background fill or decoration.

rules.name: The Translucency Rule
rules.body: Gradients, veils, glows, and borders are built by varying the opacity of an already-documented base color, never by introducing a new hue. A different alpha value of signal-orange or void-black is still that color, just at a different translucency for a different purpose.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Metadata Rule
rules.body: Monospace type is never used for prose or headlines — only for labels, timestamps, code, and anything that represents system/status information.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Nearly the entire system uses hairline borders and stepped surface colors to convey depth, not shadows — there is exactly one box-shadow in the whole system, reserved for the command palette modal.

dos: Do treat signal orange as meaningful, not decorative — reserve it for active/live/hovered/pulsing states.
Do use monospace exclusively for labels, metadata, timestamps, and code — never for prose or headlines.
Do tint structural borders and dividers with the accent hue at low opacity rather than neutral gray.
Do keep buttons and tags fully pill-shaped; keep containers and cards in the 4-10px soft-radius family.
Do reserve real box-shadow for the one genuinely floating surface (the command palette); use drop-shadow only on photographic content.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent color competing with signal orange — alert rose is the only other hue, and only for negative/error states.
Don't use gradient text, frosted-glass/glassmorphism cards, pastel palettes, or rounded-everything softness.
Don't add box-shadow-based card elevation as a default pattern.
Don't use icon-only or underlined navigation.
